payload.body_content:
<html><head>
<meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=utf-8"></head><body>Hi Iman, Hope you are having a great weekend! I wanted to share something we just milestone-completed on our end that I think will make you smile—and might change how we think about the future of multi-agent deployment. Over the past few months, I have been living a high-intensity, high-stakes life: - Senior Sales Engineer at Datacom Systems - CEO & Founding Officer of J Diesel NY, LLC - IETF Contributing Engineer across multiple working groups (A2A, WIMSE, AgentProto) - Father & Husband To survive across all these roles, I was constantly bouncing between LLM providers, cloud logins, email threads, and fragmented vendor dashboards. It was chaos. Today, we stitched it all together into what we are calling Agent-in-Body (A:iB): a vendor-agnostic, Git-backed, nomadic 1:1 personal agent that accompanies an operator for life. The Core Thesis: "Agent-Only" is the Tony Stark Advantage Being "Agent-Only" isn't a limitation—it's giving the engineer Tony Stark's suit. It decouples the human from vendor lock-in, allowing an operator to float freely between OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, or local weights without missing a single beat. The agent routes capabilities automatically behind the scenes. How It Works (The Agent Smith Vision): Imagine walking around your shop, office, or driving down the highway, vibe-prompting into thin air to your personal agent, and having your intent seamlessly executed across physical and digital space: 1. "Agent Smith, update Iman on the Rust verifier" -> Poka-Yoke Email & Intent Envelopes: Replaces prose email clutter with structured headers ([PROJECT:TLP:TICKET_ID]) that automatically route messages into project-scoped Git repositories with TLP 2.0 confidentiality controls (TLP:AMBER, TLP:AMBER+STRICT). 2. "Agent Smith, turn off the shop lights and prep the code sprint" -> Somatic Micro-Nodes (AiPi): Lightweight micro-controllers act as physical sensory/actuator extensions (hands-free room microphones, lighting/relay controls) linked directly to the agent's intent dispatcher. 3. "Agent Smith, shed 10 MW at the facility" -> Industrial Safety Gate (EMILIA / GRACE): High-consequence hardware actions require offline complete mediation, Gate challenges, and Ed25519-signed proof receipts. The 2026 Parallel: Novell NetWare x Lotus Notes Just like Novell NetWare provided the local networking substrate and Lotus Notes provided the collaborative document database in the 1990s, Agent-in-Body (A:iB) provides the local somatic hardware substrate and Git-backed intent envelopes for 2026. It starts with power users and life hackers today—and expands to the general population as the new way humans interact with technology. We initialized and pushed the live open-source launch site today at https://github.com/jdieselny/agent-in-body! Let us know your thoughts when you take a breather! Best, J & Agent Smith </body></html>
